VT.notes: All 283 House town/House-district/Senate-district reporting splits reconcile to statewide candidate totals. 248 reporting splits map to official November 2026 VCGI voting areas. 25 entire towns are withheld for mismatched identity/split sets or overlapping reference geometry. No town aliases are inferred, no overlapping boundaries are clipped or assigned, and no votes are allocated to wards or unincorporated areas. Whole-town split sets must match. These are town-legislative reporting splits, not independently verified polling precincts. Case, whitespace, hyphens and underscores are normalized only in district labels. Source ward parts are dissolved; votes appear once per reporting split. Candidate votes are not turnout. Separate registrations, ballots and 241 provisional registered-voter fractions remain municipality-only; six municipal rates stay withheld. No municipal counts or rates are allocated to reporting splits. All original feeds, native Esri and GeoJSON geometry, unmatched rows and town-by-town audits are downloadable.
VT.next_action: Document Essex/Essex Junction municipal identities and resolve VCGI boundary overlaps; retain unmapped unincorporated areas. Resolve municipal ballot/scope discrepancies and registration definitions without assigning municipal denominators to legislative splits.

metric: Candidate margins are not participation. Separate municipal rates are not precinct rates.
